bootstrap.design: Cross five training seeds with contiguous 64-window blocks resampled within each fixed capture. Share block draws across methods/seeds and both contrasts; fixed equal capture weights. Exact tie-aware weighted AP. Jointly reject zero-positive capture draws.
bootstrap.multiplicity: Two prespecified-for-this-follow-up contrasts use 97.5% marginal percentile intervals (quantiles .0125/.9875), a nominal Bonferroni target of 95% simultaneous coverage if underlying intervals are valid. 95% intervals are also descriptive.
bootstrap.uncertainty_scope: Exploratory reuse of previously inspected test captures. Multiplicity adjustment does not undo adaptive dataset reuse. Intervals condition on these three captures, fixed training data and verified labels; block populations 60/6/5 are small in the latter captures. No confirmatory or unseen-organization inference.

calibration_audit.policy: Preserve raw scores and ranking metrics. Clip only reliability bin membership/display; require each flow exactly once.
